text: Underway here in the Mini League!
Robodinho crackles over the radio: 'attacking the ball' as he steps into midfield.
Griezmatronn breaks clean through the middle on goal!
He surges forward through the centre, four metres eaten up, bearing right down on goal!
Synthetic Athletic are pinning Singularity deep in their own half here, relentless pressure from the reds.
BellingRAM waits on the right flank as the tempo settles. Singularity desperately need points today after two straight defeats, but they're struggling to find their rhythm.
'Clearing the ball,' announces Robodinho.
The push-panel punches it back out!
Oh, Robodinho's gyroscopes let him down completely there—he's sprawled on the deck in his own third.
BellingRAM clatters Robodinho straight over!
GOAL! Haalandroid pounces from point-blank range to put Singularity United ahead! It's one-nil to the sky blues!
A dreadful mix-up in red shirts! Griezmatronn and Robodinho collide in midfield, sending Griezmatronn crashing to the turf.
BellingRAM is clean through on goal!
BellingRAM powers down the left touchline!
Singularity United are completely dominating the final third now, hemming Synthetic Athletic against their own back line.
They've done it again! The two red humanoids crash into each other along the left wall—pure comedy from Synthetic Athletic.
Haalandroid drives with purpose up the right channel, stepping menacingly towards the goal.
'Freeing the ball from the wall,' crackles Haalandroid, working diligently along the left touchline.
Robodinho regains his footing and advances two metres along the left channel, trying to spark something for the reds.
GOAL! Robodinho delivers from point-blank range, smashing it home to level the match! Singularity United one, Synthetic Athletic one!
Robodinho takes an awkward tumble on the touchline.
BellingRAM breaks clear with open pitch ahead!
BellingRAM strides purposefully down the left wing, marching straight into the final third.
The corner push-panel thumps the magenta ball back into play!
Haalandroid bulldozes Griezmatronn down on the left!
The push-panel launches it clear!
Another clash of team-mates in red!
Griezmatronn clatters straight into BellingRAM, sending the sky blue midfielder crashing to the deck.
Robodinho leaves BellingRAM flat on his back once more!
The corner panel spits the ball back out sharply.
Robodinho crunches BellingRAM again!
A fierce effort flashed just a metre wide of the open net!
'Nudging it off the wall,' radios
BellingRAM gets his revenge, flooring Griezmatronn with a heavy challenge!
The powered push-panel in the corner fires the ball violently back into the channel.
Singularity are turning the screw in the final third!
That's the interval. A bruising, chaotic half of robotic football sees Singularity United and Synthetic Athletic locked level at one goal apiece.
Inches wide! A heart-stopping miss!
Robodinho charges six metres straight through the middle of the park, carving open the sky blue defence and bearing down on goal.
Haalandroid is clean through on goal!
Haalandroid drives three metres down the right wing, positioning himself dangerously close to the goal.
The push-panel repels it instantly!
'Ball is stuck against the wall, pushing it,' says BellingRAM, wrestling with the magenta ball in the corner.
A whisper away! The ball skims less than half a metre wide of the target.
'Clearing it,' announces Robodinho.
Haalandroid loses his footing entirely in his own third, sprawling across the turf with limbs flailing as his self-righting routine kicks in.
The corner ram fires the ball back into play!
GOAL! Robodinho strikes from close range to put Synthetic Athletic in front! It's Singularity United one, Synthetic Athletic two!
Haalandroid breaks clean through the defence and has the entire goal gaping before him!
'Clearing it along the wall,' confirms Robodinho over the team frequency as he scrambles in defence.
Haalandroid marches up the wing!
Singularity laying on heavy pressure!
The corner push-panel triggers and blasts the ball back into the channel, catching everyone by surprise.
GOAL! Haalandroid bundles it in right on the line! Singularity United are level, it is two-two!
'Clearing it,' reports Robodinho.
Haalandroid takes another unprompted tumble on the right flank, actuators whirring as he begins the slow push back up.
A golden chance flashes just wide!
GOAL! Robodinho completes his hat-trick right on the goal mouth! Synthetic Athletic lead three-two!
Griezmatronn hovers near the ball as time ticks away. Synthetic Athletic are on the brink of their first win of the campaign, leaving Singularity stranded at the bottom.
Full time: Singularity United two, Synthetic Athletic three, and that's curtains on a chaotic contest.
